title: Peace Delivered, Messages of Peace:
title_q: “A Stranger Just Got a Message of Peace”
title_short: Peace Delivered · Carousels · Messages of Peace (10 × 3 slides)
format: 4:5 carousel · 1080×1350 stills (the brief asks for a 4:5 Instagram carousel)
headline: Peace is personal and it travels hand to hand: ten strangers, each in their own 3-slide carousel, the moment they get a message of peace.
story: Atdhe set the format on the design canvas: slide 1 the stranger's reaction, slide 2 the card, slide 3 the goodbye and the ask. Kalindi wants the words held the same on every set, so only the pictures change.
Ten sets are built, one stranger each, cut from the RAW MXF in the SFCG Brand Refresh 2024 look. This page is the plan for all ten; the pictures shown are set 08.
do: Same words on every set: chip, three lines and the band, exactly as written here.
One stranger per set; slides 1 and 3 are the same person.
Card flat and whole on slide 2: never crop the handwriting.
SFCG Brand Refresh 2024 type and blues; the logo only in the slide 3 band.
dont: No Preemptive Love branding. Never SFCG or CGLA as a label (sfcg.org as the web address is fine).
Do not show a card that stranger did not get under “This is what it said.”
Do not open on a close-up with no setup.

bp_intro: Still carousels, 4:5. The pictures on this page are set 08 in the Peace Delivered series folder (ten sets, cut from the RAW MXF, rendered 1080×1350). The design canvas is here (needs a sign-in). The transcript below holds the lines Kalindi says while she hands out the cards.

rows.frame_alt: An older man in a navy cap and a brown tee sits on a bench with a guitar and smiles to the side. Chip at the top: PEACE, DELIVERED. White text low: A stranger just got a message of peace.
rows.visual: The stranger's reaction the moment the card lands, one stranger per set. The example here is set 08, the man with the guitar (01_reaction.jpg). All ten sets: 01 Emma on the bench, Washington Square Park · 02 Catherine on the bench, Washington Square Park · 03 The couple on the bench, Washington Square Park · 04 Reading in the grass, Washington Square Park · 05 Stepping off the train, Marcy Ave · 06 The platform crowd, Marcy Ave · 07 The nurse on the platform, Marcy Ave · 08 The man with the guitar, Marcy Ave bench · 09 The man with the beard, on the train · 10 The man with the headphones, on the train.
rows.motion: Hook text on slide 1, the same on every set: A stranger just got a message of peace. White, low in the frame. Chip at the top: PEACE, DELIVERED. No logo, no title card.

rows.frame_alt: On a light cream background, the back of an SFCG postcard with a handwritten note: You may have not heard it lately, but I'm proud of you. Dark blue text low: This is what it said.
rows.visual: The card itself, flat, on the light cream background (02_card.jpg). Set 08 shows the handwritten side. Some sets show the art side (a drawing with no words), and sets 03 and 05 use the same sunflower card picture. Handwriting stays whole: never crop a message mid-word.
rows.motion: Text low, the same on every set: <q>This is what it said.</q> Chip at the top: <q>PEACE, DELIVERED</q>.
rows.voice: No voice: still slide. The card's own words are the message.

rows.frame_alt: The man with the guitar smiles again. White text: Now it's your turn to pass it on. A blue band at the bottom: Become a monthly donor, sfcg.org, and the white Search for Common Ground logo.
rows.visual: The goodbye or the last reaction, the same stranger as slide 1 (03_goodbye.jpg). The blue band with the SFCG logo sits at the bottom. The logo is on this slide only.
rows.motion: Text, the same on every set: <q>Now it's your turn to pass it on.</q> Blue band at the bottom: <q>Become a monthly donor</q> · <q>sfcg.org</q> and the white SFCG horizontal logo.

Thirty JPGs, 1080×1350, one folder per set. Upload named Traditional_SFCGPeaceDeliveredMessagesCarousel001-1_set01_01.jpg and so on, to the Search for Common Ground folder in Frame.io (no batch folder yet: tell Nick).
checklist: Every set has three slides in the order reaction, card, goodbye.
The words are the same on every set, spelled as on this page.
Slide 2 shows the card that stranger got, whole and flat.
Slides 1 and 3 show the same person.
The logo is only in the slide 3 band.
No child's face on any slide.

decisions.t: Post them, or close the item
decisions.b: The Peace Delivered push ran 1 to 21 Sept. The ten sets were built on 2 Sept and never went to SFCG. Atdhe decides: send them to Kalindi now as evergreen Peace Delivered posts, or close the item.

“This is what it said.” sits over the art side of the card in several sets (a drawing, no words), and sets 03 and 05 show the same sunflower card. Atdhe confirms each stranger really got the card shown, or the line changes for those sets.
Confirm releases for Emma (01), Catherine (02) and the reader (04) before they front a donor ask. Set 04 never shows the card clearly: keep or drop it.
Atdhe signs off the fixed lines and the band wording against SFCG's monthly-donor ask.
